title: Call of Duty: World at War
provenance: Reported by valdroff (highball-db#364, 2026-10-06 and 2026-10-08), Apple M3, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.11, the Steam release: rated 2 of 5 in Wine's own Direct3D mode (menus and loading fine, very slow in play even at very low settings), then playable with a few slowdowns after switching the environment to automatic and turning on Emulate display mode changes. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Playable with a few slowdowns in automatic mode with Emulate display mode changes on, per the reporter. Wine's own Direct3D mode was very slow in play. On the default engine, automatic mode runs the game's Direct3D 9 through DXVK. No measurement here yet.

knownIssues.symptom: Very low frame rate in play, even at the lowest settings
knownIssues.cause: the environment was set to Wine's own Direct3D (wined3d)
knownIssues.fix: Set the environment's graphics back to Automatic, and turn on Emulate display mode changes on the game's page under Game settings.
